intro: Paris Hilton and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez are pressing Congress to pass the Defiance Act, already approved by the Senate, to criminalize AI-generated deepfake pornography. Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share, above its anticipated range, valuing the AI company at approximately $1.5 trillion and setting up one of the largest public offerings in history. A new study found that one-third of young people across 16 countries have used AI as a social companion, raising concerns about loneliness and mental health among youth.
